      • Time:

      • Flanders in Points streams DHMV II — the Flemish government’s national LiDAR survey, flown 2013–2015 at ≥ 8 points/m² — straight into this browser tab. No install, no download, no desktop GIS.

        The survey is read as COPC directly from Amazon S3, where Flai hosts its own COPC conversion of the original DHMV II LAZ tiles: a reduced-detail overview and 78,809 full-resolution tiles. The viewer shows them as one model and requests only the byte ranges your current view needs. There is no backend of its own.

        A research demonstration built at Ghent University on public open data. Every point here is DHMV II — the survey is not ours, and neither are this COPC conversion or its hosting.

        • How it works
      • 1 DHMV II
        Open LiDAR survey of Flanders by Digitaal Vlaanderen.
        2 Flai on Amazon S3
        Flai’s own COPC conversion of the original LAZ tiles: an overview, 78,809 tiles of 500 × 500 m, and a catalogue API.
        3 This viewer
        Potree-Next, reduced to what one deployment needs, streaming overview and tiles as one octree over HTTP byte ranges.
        • Built on
      • Digitaal Vlaanderen The DHMV II survey itself — flown, processed, and released openly.
        Flai Their COPC conversion of the DHMV II LAZ tiles, the overview and the catalogue API, hosted on Amazon S3. Their Lidar Hub viewer inspired how tiles are streamed here.
        Hobu, Inc. The COPC specification. Range requests into plain files, no special server.
        Markus Schütz Potree and Potree-Next — a decade of rendering massive point clouds in a browser, and the COPC support underneath this page. AGPL-3.0.

        Base map © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL); geocoding by Photon/Komoot. Bundled browser libraries keep their own licences.

        • Licence

      • The code is AGPL-3.0-only, inherited from Potree-Next. Because you are using it over a network, § 13 applies and the source of this deployment is public: github.com/flol3622/DHMVII_potree-next (branch feat/flai-dhmvii-source).

        The data is not ours to license. DHMV II is Flemish government open data under the Gratis Open Data Licentie Vlaanderen, whose core condition is attribution to the data owner. The COPC files are Flai’s conversion, hosted by Flai; see hub.flai.ai for their terms.

        Use it, fly through it, screenshot it, cite it. Suggested attribution:

        Point cloud: DHMV II, © Digitaal Vlaanderen, open data (Gratis Open Data Licentie Vlaanderen). COPC conversion and hosting: Flai (hub.flai.ai), on Amazon S3. Viewer: Flanders in Points, AGPL-3.0, derived from Potree-Next (Markus Schütz). Format: COPC (Hobu, Inc.).

        • Funding

      • This work has been (partially) funded by the Flanders AI Research program, and carried out at Ghent University.
